    // compute sum of values[r % n] across rounds

#include "library.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

extern "C" {

int64_t repeated_sort(const int* input, size_t input_length, int rounds) {
    if (!input && input_length != 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    if (input_length == 0 || rounds <= 0) {
        return 0;
    }

    try {
        std::vector<int> values(input, input + input_length);
        std::sort(values.begin(), values.end());

        const size_t n = values.size();
        const int median = (n % 2 == 0)
            ? static_cast<int>((static_cast<int64_t>(values[n / 2 - 1]) + values[n / 2]) / 2)
            : values[n / 2];

        int64_t total = static_cast<int64_t>(median) * rounds;

        // Compute sum of values[r % n] across rounds efficiently
        int64_t sum_all = 0;
        for (int v : values) {
            sum_all += v;
        }

        size_t full_cycles = static_cast<size_t>(rounds) / n;
        size_t remainder = static_cast<size_t>(rounds) % n;

        total += sum_all * static_cast<int64_t>(full_cycles);

        for (size_t i = 0; i < remainder; ++i) {
            total += values[i];
        }

        return total;
    } catch (...) {
        return 0;
    }
}

}
